key_themes: Fed hawkish shock: Warsh's first FOMC leaves rates at 3.5-3.75% but dot plot surges to 3.8% median, signaling late-2026 rate hike
SpaceX (SPCX) post-IPO volatility: shares reverse gains, falling ~5% as macro headwinds hit newly-public meme-stock darling
Chemicals sector M&A: Huntsman + Olin announce $12B+ all-stock merger of equals to form OlinHuntsman Corp

stocks.reason: Post-IPO (debuted June 12 at $135) shares fell ~5% today as hawkish Fed signals and bond yield spike deflated meme-stock momentum; CNBC flagged technical factors driving outsized volatility
Q4 FY2026 earnings crushed estimates: EPS $1.26 vs. $0.82 consensus; revenue $570.34M vs. $569.23M est.; announced $300M share buyback; shares surged ~17.7% after hours
Q1 FY2027 earnings beat: EPS $1.31 vs. $0.96 est.; revenue $8.01B vs. $7.39B est.; stock pulled back ~2.4% premarket despite the beat as investors remain cautious on outlook
Shares soared ~75% after FDA agreed with company's plan to file a Biologics License Application for its gene therapy targeting Huntington's disease, clearing a major regulatory milestone
Announced $12B+ all-stock merger of equals with Olin Corp to form OlinHuntsman Corporation; Mizuho upgraded to Neutral from Underperform (PT $14 from $10) on deal announcement
Announced $12B+ all-stock merger of equals with Huntsman Corp; deal expected to generate $400M+ in cost synergies; OlinHuntsman HQ to be in Texas under Olin CEO Ken Lane
Rothschild & Co Redburn upgraded to Buy from Neutral, raising PT to $22 from $17, arguing autonomous vehicles will drive substantial TAM expansion for ride-hailing platforms
Shares up ~3.6% to $121.28 after Intel announced its 18A-P process node entered risk production at the 2026 VLSI Symposium, meeting its timeline; Bernstein raised PT from $65 to $100
Shares up ~7% as activist investor Findell Capital pushes board to review governance and relationship with Anthropic following Claude Design launch; Config 2026 AI revenue beat also in focus
BofA downgraded to Neutral from Buy; slashed PT from $200 to $125 citing increasing pressure across the "once blooming" healthcare IT portfolio
Morgan Stanley analyst David Bailey downgraded to Equal-Weight from Overweight; PT cut from $286 to $230, flagging lack of clear drivers of upside relative to peers
Morgan Stanley upgraded to Overweight from Equal Weight; PT raised to $220 from $185, citing strong uptick in biopharma funding now transitioning into RFPs and bookings
Surged ~187% after reporting a 70% jump in active U.S. commercial install base for its breast cancer cryoablation system, signaling rapid post-FDA-clearance adoption
Shares climbed ~5-6% in premarket after company announced successful launch of three new satellites into orbit, expanding its direct-to-device broadband constellation
